overlap.rationale_zh: 与 1.1.1 体脂核心项为同一指标；研究只校正年龄、性别和研究，系数压到 0.3

population.cohort: Global BMI Mortality Collaboration, east Asia stratum (never-smokers without chronic disease, first 5 years excluded)
population.ancestry: East Asian (east Asia stratum of 189-study analysis)
population.events_source_zh: 摘要给出全部 189 项研究的 never-smoker 死亡数 385 879；东亚层单独死亡数在全文表格

evidence.quote: For BMI 25 kg/m2 or more, the association of BMI with all-cause mortality was approximately log-linear, and of similar strength in each region (except perhaps south Asia, where numbers of deaths were small), with HR per 5 kg/m2 units higher BMI 1·31 (95% CI 1·29–1·33) overall, 1·39 (1·34–1·44) in east Asia
evidence.estimand_zh: 观察性 HR：东亚队列，从不吸烟、基线无慢性病、排除前 5 年随访，BMI>25 部分每升高 5 kg/m2；偏瘦一侧原文仅给分类 HR，不折成斜率，故不录入 hr_below
